content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-59. - Payments validate contract.

faqs.a:
To the extent the city makes any payment thereunder, a contract or agreement under
               the preceding section shall be valid, and any such payment may be included in any
               cost defrayed by the levy of assessments unless theretofore the city elects to void
               the contract or the agreement in its entirety and to recover any such payment from
               the party to whom made.
(Code 1981, § 27-60; Ord. No. 551, § 19(K), 5-14-1964)
